title: Amphora Founder Readiness Brief
authority_precedence: module capability profiles and hash-bound benchmark artifacts

declared_fixed_constraints: volume solids approximately 65 percent plus or minus 2 percent
dry film thickness approximately 4.5 to 6.0 mil per coat
mvp20_feedback_v5_input.authority_interpretation: The files define intended use and constraints; they do not authorize a formulation, synthesis, safety, procurement, qualification, novelty, or performance conclusion.

compound_mvp_model.initial_win: Demonstrate one deterministic mixed cohort containing known Generation-0 controls and unmade unknown proposals, with identical module traversal, explicit origin labels, auditable attention flags, and no hidden rank.
known_generation_zero_examples: EA-P10 Bisphenol A diglycidyl ether model
EA-P09 Bisphenol F diglycidyl ether model
compound_mvp_model.attention_flag_semantics: INTERESTING_FOR_AUDIT is a non-ranking workflow flag. It must never be represented as novelty, superiority, compliance, procurement suitability, or product performance.
compound_mvp_model.reaction_hypothesis_interpretation: The examples are exact host request records from config/program/epoxy-amine-compound-campaign.v1.json. No product structure is invented; ORD reaction and dataset lineage must be added by a future locked grammar run.
authority_locks: Unknown proposals are unmade digital proposals.
No safety, synthesis, procurement, qualification, performance, or execution claim is authorized.
compound_mvp_model.mvp_acceptance_signal: One hash-bound replay recovers all four known controls; records at least one valid unmade proposal from each authorized reaction family with complete lineage and 29 typed outcomes; retains rejects and duplicates; ingests one independently measured, signed, candidate-bound return; and emits RANK: NONE with FINAL AGGREGATE SCORE: NOT AUTHORIZED.
compound_mvp_model.mvp_kill_or_hold_criteria: Toolchain or replay mismatch, known-control miss, unsupported lineage, missing family coverage, rights or custody failure, held-out leakage, signer conflict, baseline non-superiority, hidden rank, aggregate-score injection, or pressure to broaden the signed domain.

status_contract.GREEN_SIGNED_PHASE_0: Signed deterministic Phase-0 control; auditable validator or enforcement readiness only, not scientific or product validity.
status_contract.YELLOW_IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE_PROMOTION: Implementation and deterministic rehearsal are complete, but current phase remains PRE_PHASE_0 pending live reissue, evaluation, independent review, and movement.
status_contract.RED_SUBSTANTIVE_CLOSURE_REQUIRED: Scientific, data, rights, CRO, procurement, legal, or external evidence closure is required; this is promotion risk, not a code-quality grade.
